lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in vertical columns of 3 to 4 nodes along the mid-flank, transitioning to a higher-density, less-ordered distribution of smaller spots in the anterior region near the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary spot nodes, creating a visible orthogonal grid pattern most prominent in the central lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a specular light edge on the superior side and a shadow-cast inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance nodes, clustered mainly toward the leading edge and the base of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, low-luminance biological features (remoras) are visible in the water column immediately ventral to the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin.
